stem.x: Based on the requirements gathered, the cost of a software project under normal conditions is estimated at $70,000. In case of smooth project implementation, some activities are not required and the estimated cost is reduced to $50,000; however, in the worst-case scenario, additional tasks are required and the cost increases to $120,000. What is the expected cost of the project (in dollars) that is calculated by using the three-point estimate in the beta distribution, also known as PERT?
